newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - Le Monde - June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - Le Monde - June 10.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government decides to legalize status of some 20,000 to 40,000 illegal immigrants, as it pledged during its campaign for the June 1 parliamentary election.

-- Renault chairman Louis Schweitzer expected to announce at board meeting today he will appoint an independent expert to review possible alternative solutions to a planned shutdown of the Renault Vilvoorde, Belgium assembly plant, which may include cost cutting and shorter work hours.
-- Andre Tarallo to be replaced by Jean-Francois Gavalda as head of Elf Aquitaine oil group Africa subsidiary Elf Gabon.
